details.objective: Implement P-MP3 shadow provider routing as recommendation/evidence only, with no automatic dispatch, orchestration route transition, controller transfer, write-lease mutation, or public MCP tool change. Add a small pure provider_routing module with strict bounded task features and deterministic recommendations aligned to current policy: deterministic mutation -> MCP deterministic; broad read-only -> OpenCode Flash; broad read-only + hard reasoning -> OpenCode Pro; localized + strong oracle -> Codex Mini; localized/bounded harder leaf -> Codex Luna; bounded/cross-file with localized evidence and normal/low latency -> Terra; high/critical risk or consequential mutation -> manual controller/deep review gate rather than OpenCode auto execution. Add idempotent shadow_route_recommended audit events keyed by canonical feature hash, recent shadow-route projection, and an internal routing_evidence projection that pairs recommendations with actual delegations and canonical UsageEvents for later cohort calibration. Expose internal /__control/hub action=shadow_route restricted to electron-panel/electron and bound to the current active task-projected nonterminal run/wave, including PREFLIGHT/READY before actual route selection. Tests must prove recommendations, idempotency, and that shadow_route leaves actual orchestration route/state/controller/write fence/provider adapter untouched. Preserve Smart-v3 8 tools, current production routing thresholds, OpenCode worker-only role, UI, settings, and service state. No provider inference, restart, commit, push, release, or deploy.
